title: Retund
summary: RETUND', verb transitive [Latin retundo; re and rundo, to beat.] To blunt; to turn; as an edge; to dull; as, to retund the edge of a weapon.

inlines.v: RETUND', verb transitive [Latin retundo; re and rundo, to beat.] To blunt; to turn; as an edge; to dull; as, to retund the edge of a weapon.
